name: @cimo/form-data_parser
description: Parser for the form-data request. Light, fast and secure.
author: cimo

scripts.delete_dist: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); try{ fs.rmdirSync('./dist/', { recursive: true }) } catch{}; process.exit(0);"
scripts.delete_build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); try{ fs.rmdirSync('./build/', { recursive: true }) } catch{}; process.exit(0);"
scripts.build_library: npm run delete_build && tsc --build tsconfig.json && npm pack && mkdir -p ./build/ && mv *.tgz ./build/
scripts.build: npm run build_tsc && npm run check && npm run build_library
